Vampire skills (Capitalized means Superior) :

an = Animalism au = Auspex ce = Celerity
do = Dominate fo = Fortitude ob = Obfuscate

th = Thaumaturgy

# = # from blood pool

Rarity Levels
R = Rare (1/19)
U = Uncommon (3/19)
V = Vampire (4/19) v = Non-Vampire, on Vampire sheet

Typos:
Arson : The flavor text is actualey from the song "Hot! Hot! Hot!"
Disputed Territory: The political icon was not printed.
Cat Burglary : Superior option is not in bold print, this is ok as both
regular and superior effects are the same due to the
rules.
Eco Terrorists : The cards says "add1" instead of "add 1".
Fists of Death : The number is off center of the blood drop.
Golconda : Artist is Kaja Foglio, not Kaja Folio.
Hostile Take Over : Artist is Mike Raabe, not Mike Kaabe.
Masquerade Endangered: The cards says "instRead" instead of "instead".
The 4th Tradition : This is a minion card, it is printed with the master
(gray) background.
The Spawning Pool : This is a master card, it is printed with the minon
(red) background.
Venture Justicar : The title is incorrect, it should be Ventrue Justicar.
Also wherever the card refers to Tremere substitute
Ventrue.
Zip Gun card : Artist is Kaja Foglio, not Kaja Fogllo.

Bastard Sword : Illustrator spacing is different

IR Goggles : Text spacing is different.
J.S. Simmons Esq. : Title spacing is different.

Psychic Projection: Psychic/Physchic, in title of card.
Pulling Strings : Text spacing is different.
Rampage : Text spacing is different.
Renegade Garou : Renegade/Renagade, in title of card.
Submachine Gun : Illustrator spacing is different.
Tasha Morgan : One has "All Kindred". Different artist listed for each.

Wolf Companion : Text spacing is different.
